name: Engineering, Ph.D. (Civil and Environmental Engineering)

deadline.value: Fall I priority deadline is April 30, 2027 (final deadline July 15, 2027); applications are reviewed on a rolling basis as received, with priority filing recommended for full consideration.
deadline.quote: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis as they are received. To receive full consideration, apply by the priority deadline. | Priority Deadline | April 30 | Final Deadline | July 15

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists in Civil Engineering; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants must identify a faculty member willing to serve as their graduate faculty advisor prior to admission and will not be admitted without an advisor.
supervisor.quote: Students seeking admission to the PhD in Engineering program must identify a faculty member willing to serve as their graduate faculty advisor. | Applicants will not be admitted to the program without a graduate advisor.

funding.value: Graduate teaching assistantships and grant-funded research assistantships may be available through the College of Engineering and Computer Science; 50% FTE assistantships qualify non-resident/international students for in-state tuition rates under Texas Education Code 54.212.
funding.quote: Graduate teaching assistantships and research assistantships may be available, depending on available institutional and external grant funding.

also.quote: A number of fellowships, research assistantships, and teaching assistantships are available to graduate level students through the College of Engineering.

According to the Texas Education Code, Section 54.212, non-resident students receiving a 50% FTE graduate assistantship will receive in-state tuition and fees at the rate charged to Texas residents for the semester in which they hold the assistantship appointment.

entry_route.value: Typically requires a master's degree in engineering or a closely related field (48 SCH minimum), though exceptional applicants with a bachelor's degree in engineering may be considered for direct Ph.D. admission (81 SCH minimum).
entry_route.quote: To get started, you’ll need a master's degree in engineering or a closely related field. Exceptional applicants with a bachelor's degree in engineering may also be considered for direct admission to the Ph.D. program.

notes: Civil and Environmental Engineering concentration within the Ph.D. in Engineering (also offers Electrical and Advanced Manufacturing, Industrial and Process, and Mechanical and Energy Engineering concentrations). Neither the program page nor the 2026-2027 catalog mentions a GRE requirement for Engineering Ph.D., so GRE General remains Not stated.
